notes.Giannis Antetokounmpo: His first game for Miami comes in a 240.5-point game, one of the highest totals on the slate, and the Heat lean on him and Bam Adebayo up front.
notes.Luka Doncic: With LeBron gone, he should carry the league's highest usage, and the Warriors are missing Podziemski, Butler, Porzingis and Moody.
notes.Paolo Banchero: Anthony Black is out, which puts even more of Orlando's creation on Banchero and Franz Wagner.
notes.Tyrese Haliburton: Aaron Nesmith and T.J. McConnell are both out, so Indiana's ball runs through Haliburton and Andrew Nembhard.
notes.Grayson Allen: Kon Knueppel and Coby White are both out, so Allen starts and should push past 30 minutes early.
notes.Dennis Schroder: With Coby White out, he runs the point for Charlotte and could play about 30 minutes.
notes.Kris Dunn: Beal, Ingram, Strus and Konan Niederhauser are all out, so the Clippers have to lean on Dunn's minutes.
notes.Draymond Green: Podziemski is out and Curry is questionable, and Green is projected to start at center with heavy minutes.
